changelog: - **Arrow keys with Alt, Ctrl or ⌘ no longer move a node.** With a node selected and focused, an arrow key pressed with Alt, Ctrl or ⌘ moved the node and kept the key from doing anything else, so Alt+Left moved the node instead of going back in the browser. Those keys now leave the node where it is and do what they normally do. The arrow keys alone, and with Shift, move the node as before.
